explication: Limusic is a native YouTube Music desktop client. The main workflow is user browse/search and selection in the Svelte UI, backend stream resolution through the YouTube API, then playback through libmpv; the app also persists library-related state and exposes lyrics, local playback, and listening-room features. The README documents several capabilities whose detailed implementations were not sampled, so those appear as subsystem nodes with only documented or clearly owned links.
